🇩🇪 A1 GERMAN VOCABULARY: Zeit (Time)

die Nacht = night
die Stunde = hour
die Minute = minute
die Woche = week
der Monat = month
das Jahr = year

💡 Tip: Learn der/die/das with every noun.
